name: submit_decision
description: Submit your trading decision for this round for your assigned coin. You are fully autonomous: choose direction, size, and your own risk levels.

position.description: Target position after this round. 'flat' closes any open position. If you already hold this side, size_usd adjusts the position and stop/take-profit levels are updated.

size_usd.description: Target position size as USD notional (0 if flat). Capped at 5x current equity. USD notional was chosen so size is explicit, unit-identical across coins, and directly comparable to the leverage cap.

stop_loss.description: Optional stop-loss price in USD. null means no stop. Enforced between rounds on 1-minute candles.

take_profit.description: Optional take-profit price in USD. null means none. Enforced between rounds on 1-minute candles.

thesis.description: Your reasoning for this decision in 2-5 sentences. Published on the public leaderboard and shown back to you (last 3) in future rounds.

invalidation.description: REQUIRED (non-null) whenever your decision leaves you holding a long or short position; must be null when flat. The specific machine-checkable price event that would prove this thesis wrong. Evaluated mechanically by the engine; first trigger is recorded permanently.

timeframe.description: 1h_close: evaluated on each completed hourly candle close. 1m_intrabar: evaluated on each 1-minute candle's high/low.

level.description: Trigger price in USD. Must be within 0.2x to 5x the current price.

watch_condition.description: Optional when flat; must be null when holding a position. A price event that would make you re-evaluate. Informational only — never scored as invalidation.
